items.title: VeloCloud编排器SQL注入可远程利用
items.title_zh: VeloCloud编排器SQL注入可远程利用
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可通过对外接口注入SQL，访问内部特权功能，危及编排器及其管理数据的机密性、完整性与可用性
items.action_zh: 升级至5.2.3.18或6.1.3.10以上，并限制VCO管理接口公网暴露
items.repro_note: 针对on-prem VCO对外接口构造SQL注入参数验证，需自建实例
items.impact_scope: SD-WAN编排器，内网管理面核心设备
items.description: VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem has a security issue where this issue may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

items.title: Collabora命令注入可远程执行代码
items.title_zh: Collabora命令注入可远程执行代码
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可在CODE服务未运行时经proxy.php注入系统命令，远程执行代码控制Nextcloud服务器
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至26.4.303以上，或临时停用内置CODE服务
items.repro_note: 先使CODE服务停止，再向proxy.php提交命令注入参数
items.impact_scope: Nextcloud协作文档组件，常暴露公网
items.description: Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server before 26.4.303 (richdocumentscode), a Nextcloud app, allows remote code execution, as exploited in the wild in September and October 2026, a different vulnerability than CVE-2025-66208. This is an OS command injection in proxy.php when the CODE server isn't running (e.g., the product was recently restarted). The vulnerability is not present in standalone Collabora Online servers; only this deployment with CODE Server is affected.

items.title: obsidian-tc越权访问任意vault
items.summary_zh: 持有任意有效令牌者可传入input.vault，越权读写或删除其他租户vault数据，破坏多租户隔离
items.action_zh: 升级obsidian-tc至1.3.1，并校验令牌vault绑定
items.repro_note: 持低权令牌调用工具接口，将input.vault指向他人vault
items.impact_scope: 内部MCP工具，多租户数据隔离面
items.description: ### Impact Tool dispatch did not check the caller-supplied `input.vault` against the caller's bound vault (`ctx.vaultId`); the folder ACL was a single global instance and the JWT carried no vault claim. As a result, **any valid token could read, write, or delete any configured vault** by passing `input.vault`, defeating multi-tenant isolation across ~90 tool sites.

items.title: AWS多模型服务器解压遍历致RCE
items.title_zh: AWS多模型服务器解压遍历致RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者上传恶意模型归档，利用解压路径遍历写入任意文件，进而远程执行代码
items.action_zh: 产品已EOL且无修复，停用并迁移至受支持的模型服务方案
items.repro_note: 向模型加载接口上传含../路径条目的归档，触发解压写入
items.impact_scope: 模型推理服务，EOL仍在用环境
items.description: Relative path traversal during model archive extraction in Amazon Web Services Multi Model Server 1.1.11 and earlier might allow remote actors to execute arbitrary code via a crafted model archive. Multi Model Server is end of life and no fixed version is available. Users should discontinue use of Multi Model Server and migrate to a supported model serving solution.
